_readme: Drives the 'Medically reviewed by' byline and the schema.org reviewedBy property.
It is EMPTY on purpose. Nothing on this site has been clinically reviewed yet, and
labelling YMYL health content as reviewed when it has not been is the exact
fabrication Google's quality rater guidelines are written to catch.
When you engage a licensed reviewer (MBBS, MD, RD, RN, etc.):
1. Add them to 'reviewers', keyed by an id you choose.
2. List the pages they have ACTUALLY read and signed off in 'reviews',
with the date they did it.
Only pages listed in 'reviews' get the badge and the reviewedBy schema.
Removing a page from 'reviews' and re-running strips both back off it.
